metadata.description: Agent plugins for OpenCode and Claude Code.

plugins.name: debate
plugins.description: Stress-test a decision from both sides, grill a plan in frontier rounds, or write a questionnaire for someone else.

plugins.name: eli5
plugins.description: Explain a topic at five depth levels, from metaphor to frontier.

plugins.name: lang-go
plugins.description: Go skills: build, lint, go test -race, tidy and govulncheck checks, testing and fuzzing, module and package layout, and pprof profiling.

plugins.name: lang-python
plugins.description: Python skills: uv, ruff, mypy or pyright and pytest checks, testing, packaging, typing and pydantic, SQLAlchemy and Alembic, and profiling.

plugins.name: lang-rust
plugins.description: Rust skills: fmt, clippy and test checks, testing with nextest, proptest and insta, crates and workspaces, CI, sqlx persistence, Tauri and profiling.

plugins.name: lang-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript and JavaScript skills: install, lint, tsc and test checks, testing, monorepo packaging, type safety and zod, and Bun and Node profiling.

plugins.name: project
plugins.description: Project lifecycle: scaffold a project with /new-project, set up fnox and 1Password secrets, and pick an OSI-approved license.

plugins.name: toolchain
plugins.description: Toolchain defaults as skills: stack, frontend, infrastructure, languages, observability, shell, Terraform, caches, background jobs and worktree coexistence.
